item.title: Parents honor fallen Army captain with 'giving soul' after deadly Iranian strike kills six
item.summary: Parents remember Army Reserve Capt. Cody Khork as a "natural-born leader" after he was killed in an Iranian drone strike at a command center in Kuwait.

item.title: MICHAEL OREN: Iran has waged war on America for 47 years — time to end it
item.summary: The casus belli for war against Iran stems from 47 years of Iranian aggression including the 1979 embassy crisis and terrorist attacks, making Operation Epic Fury legally justified.

item.title: Hegseth warns ‘more casualties’ expected in Operation Epic Fury against Iran
item.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth warned more U.S. casualties are expected in Operation Epic Fury in Iran, with seven American soldiers already killed in the military operation.

item.title: Travel is about to get more expensive as Iran conflict sparks jet fuel crunch
item.summary: The Iran conflict has disrupted shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz, tightening jet fuel supplies and stoking fears that airfares would climb.

item.title: Tankers to resume normal movement in Middle East in 'a few weeks' at worst, Energy sec says, ending oil surge
item.summary: Oil prices surge 25% amid Trump administration's Iran targeting as Energy Secretary Chris Wright predicts "fear premium" will end in weeks, not months.

item.title: Petraeus calls for immediate sanctions on Russia over alleged intelligence support to Iran
item.summary: Gen. Petraeus urges immediate Russia sanctions as reports emerge of Moscow providing Iran intelligence support that may explain improved missile accuracy.

item.title: Michigan State star draws fresh scrutiny with kick toward opponent's groin
item.summary: Michigan State Spartans star Jeremy Fears Jr. received a technical foul for his kick toward Michigan Wolverines player Elliot Cadeau's groin on Sunday.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Trump rejects shielding Biden records from Senate probes in executive privilege showdown
item.summary: Trump overrules Biden's executive privilege claim, ordering National Archives to release documents to Congress in dispute over alleged health coverup.

item.title: Fake Google Gemini AI pushes ‘Google Coin’ crypto scam
item.summary: Crypto scam uses fake AI chatbot impersonating Google's Gemini AI to promote fraudulent "Google Coin" cryptocurrency. Malwarebytes researchers expose scam.

item.title: DHS hammers Dems over airport security lines amid funding lapse
item.summary: The Department of Homeland Security blamed Democrats for long TSA security lines amid the funding lapse, calling for them to fund the department.
